question: Tell me about a challenging project you worked on and how you handled it.
transcript: One challenging project I worked on was a deep learning voice interview coach. The difficult part was handling a large video dataset and converting it into clean audio files for training. I solved this by building a preprocessing pipeline, extracting audio, creating user-independent splits, and preparing the data for model training. I also coordinated with my team to divide the deep learning model training and feedback agent implementation.
